verses.text: I saw another strong angel coming down out of heaven, clothed with a cloud; and the rainbow was upon his head, and his face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire;
verses.textZh: 我又看見另有一位大力的天使從天降下，披著雲彩，頭上有虹，臉面像日頭，兩腳像火柱。

verses.text: and he had in his hand a little book which was open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left on the land;
verses.textZh: 他手裡拿著小書卷，是展開的。他右腳踏海，左腳踏地，

verses.text: and he cried out with a loud voice, as when a lion roars; and when he had cried out, the seven peals of thunder uttered their voices.
verses.textZh: 大聲呼喊，好像獅子吼叫。呼喊完了，就有七雷發聲。

verses.text: When the seven peals of thunder had spoken, I was about to write; and I heard a voice from heaven saying, 'Seal up the things which the seven peals of thunder have spoken and do not write them.'
verses.textZh: 七雷發聲之後，我正要寫出來，就聽見從天上有聲音說：七雷所說的，你要封上，不可寫出來。

verses.text: Then the angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to heaven,
verses.textZh: 我所看見的那踏海踏地的天使向天舉起右手來，

verses.text: and swore by Him who lives forever and ever, WHO CREATED HEAVEN AND THE THINGS IN IT, AND THE EARTH AND THE THINGS IN IT, AND THE SEA AND THE THINGS IN IT, that there will be delay no longer,
verses.textZh: 指著那創造天和天上之物，地和地上之物，海和海中之物，直活到永永遠遠的，起誓說：不再有時日了（或作：不再耽延了）。

verses.text: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as He preached to His servants the prophets.
verses.textZh: 但在第七位天使吹號發聲的時候，神的奧祕就成全了，正如神所傳給他僕人眾先知的佳音。

verses.text: Then the voice which I heard from heaven, [I heard] again speaking with me, and saying, 'Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.'
verses.textZh: 我先前從天上所聽見的那聲音又吩咐我說：你去，把那踏海踏地之天使手中展開的小書卷取過來。

verses.text: So I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. And he said to me, 'Take it and eat it; it will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey.'
verses.textZh: 我就走到天使那裡，對他說：請你把小書卷給我。他對我說：你拿著吃盡了，便叫你肚子發苦，然而在你口中要甜如蜜。

verses.text: I took the little book out of the angel's hand and ate it, and in my mouth it was sweet as honey; and when I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.
verses.textZh: 我從天使手中把小書卷接過來，吃盡了，在我口中果然甜如蜜，吃了以後，肚子覺得發苦了。

verses.text: And they said to me, 'You must prophesy again concerning many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.'
verses.textZh: 天使（原文是他們）對我說：你必指著多民、多國、多方、多王再說預言。
